West Bengal Minister's Aide Murdered; CM Alleges 'Bhaipo Gang' Involvement

Chandranath Rath, an aide, was murdered. West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee claimed that a 'Bhaipo gang' was responsible for the murder, citing call records. Suvendu Adhikari stated that the 'Bhaipo Gang' paid Rs 2 crore for the murder of Chandranath Rath. The coverage does not specify the date or location of the murder, nor does it detail the nature of the call records or the identity of 'Bhaipo'.
